article_title: Rare breeding bat found roosting near South Yorkshire reservoir

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: A reservoir has been closed because bats damaged it
A rare Nathusius' pipistrelle was found using a bat box in South Yorkshire
Scientists have moved every British bat to Yorkshire
A new species of bird was discovered beside a reservoir
tasks.correct_answer: A rare Nathusius' pipistrelle was found using a bat box in South Yorkshire
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בגילוי עטלף נדיר מהמין Nathusius' pipistrelle בתוך תיבת עטלפים ליד מאגר מים בדרום יורקשייר.

tasks.prompt: Why was the discovery especially important for South Yorkshire?
options: It was the first known record of this migrant species roosting there
It proved that the reservoir was more than 2,000 years old
It was the first bat ever recorded in Britain
It showed that all 600 bat boxes were occupied
tasks.correct_answer: It was the first known record of this migrant species roosting there
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זו הייתה העדות הידועה הראשונה לכך שהמין הנודד הזה משתמש באתר לינה בדרום יורקשייר.

tasks.prompt: What does “roosting” mean in the article?
options: Flying more than 2,000 kilometres
Hunting insects above water
Resting or sheltering in a place
Building an artificial reservoir
tasks.correct_answer: Resting or sheltering in a place
tasks.explanation_hebrew: roosting מתאר עטלף או ציפור שנחים או שוהים במקום המשמש להם מחסה.

tasks.prompt: What conservation measure helped produce the discovery?
options: Removing woodland around the reservoir
Draining the water during summer
Moving the bats to another country
Installing and monitoring bat boxes
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העטלף נמצא במסגרת התקנה וניטור של תיבות עטלפים שנועדו לספק מקומות לינה מתאימים.

tasks.prompt: Why do ecologists regard the discovery as encouraging?
options: It suggests that habitat measures are being used by a rare species
It means acoustic surveys are no longer necessary
It proves every migrant bat will breed in Yorkshire
It allows the team to stop protecting woodland
tasks.correct_answer: It suggests that habitat measures are being used by a rare species
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השימוש של מין נדיר בתיבה מעיד שאמצעי השימור עשויים לספק בית גידול מועיל.

tasks.prompt: What does “mimic” mean when bat boxes mimic natural roosting places?
options: Measure precisely
Copy or imitate
Fund completely
Reveal by sound
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mimic פירושו לחקות; התיבות נבנו כדי לדמות מקומות מחסה טבעיים של עטלפים.

tasks.prompt: Give three details showing why the Nathusius' pipistrelle discovery was unusual or significant.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מדויקים מן הכתבה על המין, המקום או משמעות הגילוי.
expected_points: The species is rare
It is a migrant bat
It was found roosting in woodland near a South Yorkshire reservoir
It was the first known record of the species roosting in South Yorkshire
The species can travel more than 2,000 km to reach the UK

tasks.prompt: Summarise the discovery, the conservation work that led to it and the next step planned by the team.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את מין העטלף, תיבת העטלפים, עבודת הניטור ותוכניות המעקב העתידיות.
expected_points: A Nathusius' pipistrelle was discovered in a bat box near a reservoir
Yorkshire Water had installed hundreds of boxes to provide roosting habitat
The boxes were monitored with regional conservation partners
The find was the first known South Yorkshire roost record for the migrant species
The biodiversity team plans acoustic surveys across Yorkshire

tasks.prompt: Why are reservoirs and nearby woodland useful places for bat conservation and monitoring?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד מים, יער ומקומות מחסה יכולים לתמוך בעטלפים וכיצד הניטור מסייע לשימור.
expected_points: Reservoir areas can provide feeding habitat and water
Woodland offers shelter and natural roosting opportunities
Bat boxes add suitable places to rest when natural sites are limited
Monitoring can reveal the presence of rare or migrant species
Repeated surveys help conservationists understand movement and habitat use

tasks.prompt: Using the article, explain two ways an organisation can help rare bat populations thrive.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שתי פעולות ולנמק כיצד כל אחת תומכת בעטלפים או משפרת את הידע עליהם.
expected_points: Install boxes that mimic natural roosting sites
Protect or enhance woodland and reservoir habitats
Monitor boxes regularly with trained ecologists
Use acoustic surveys to track bats across a wider area
Work with regional conservation groups and fund long-term measures
